purpose: Use the historical-data policy to screen additional independent hypotheses without downloading, calculating, or inspecting any candidate return series.

candidates.name: CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM_STATIC_SURVIVOR_UNIVERSE
candidates.reason: A recent Binance-perpetual replication reports that the allowed cross-sectional momentum specifications are not distinguishable from zero after realistic costs. More importantly, a current surviving-symbol universe would only qualify as a diagnostic under the project policy and cannot promote to live evidence. This overlaps the failed Alpha 006/008 momentum family.
candidates.retain: Do not create an additional parameterized momentum trial. Reconsider only with a contemporaneously timestamped historical membership source and an independently preregistered forward protocol.

candidates.name: FUNDING_RATE_ARBITRAGE
candidates.reason: The documented strategy requires a spot or cross-venue hedge to neutralize the perpetual price exposure. It is therefore a different capital, custody, borrowing, and liquidation system from the requested Binance USDT-M-futures-only portfolio, and overlaps failed funding/carry family trials.
candidates.retain: Keep as a risk and funding-accounting reference, not as an alpha candidate.

candidates.name: PRICE_VOLUME_PERPETUAL_FACTOR_SORTS
candidates.reason: The cited working paper reports statistically significant perpetual-return predictors, but the accessible record does not provide enough executable signal, universe, turnover, or cost detail to preregister one unambiguously. A static current-symbol reconstruction would violate the historical-evidence policy for any promotion claim.
candidates.retain: Require complete reproducible methods, publisher-bound source fields, an independent cost model, and a point-in-time membership source before opening a trial.

candidates.name: CROSS_VENUE_WORLD_ORDER_FLOW
candidates.reason: The reported predictor uses international multi-currency order flow. Binance-only public USD-M data cannot reproduce that information set, so replacing it with Binance local flow would be a different, unvalidated hypothesis and overlaps Alpha 011/013 order-flow research.
candidates.retain: Continue the already preregistered Binance-specific forward order-flow tests rather than create a post-hoc substitute.

selected_next_step: NO_NEW_EXPERIMENT; run archival diagnostics only under the historical evidence policy while Alpha 011, Alpha 013, and the point-in-time universe accumulate forward observations.
